# omni_user_group (Resource)

Manages an Omni user group and its membership. Requires an organization API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omni_user_group" "finance" {
  display_name = "Finance"

  member_ids = [
    omni_user.blob.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The group name. Maximum 64 characters.

### Optional

- `member_ids` (Set of String) User IDs that belong to the group. Membership is authoritative: users removed from this set are removed from the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group's unique ID.
